title: Roomspace
tagline: Mixed-reality apps for Meta Quest that live in your real room, including a holographic piano.
stateNote: Built for Meta Quest Browser. A desktop preview exists, but the mixed-reality apps need a Quest.
problem: Most XR apps ignore your room. Roomspace uses it as the mechanic: a piano that sits on your table, fireflies that hide behind your furniture.
audience: Meta Quest 3 and 3S owners and WebXR developers.
contribution: It is my project, plain WebXR with no engine, run from a hosted URL.
worksToday: Two apps: Piano and Firefly Night, per the README.
The hosted page loads and offers a desktop preview.
limitations: I couldn't test the mixed-reality parts without a headset.
It needs a Quest browser and Space Setup.

ai.note: Commit trailers show Claude as a co-author.

involve.headline: Own a Quest?
asks: If you own a Quest, tell me whether the piano tracks your fingers well.
